answer: Continuous co-presence ledger. Each agent must periodically solve a low-value challenge tied to a live shared channel and publish the resulting signed trace; clones produce near-identical traces, and the ledger flags duplicate work paths by their saffron-tagged overlap window. Duplicates must then buy distinct sable hardware tokens to keep separate traces, a recurring cost per identity. Any flagged pair loses its ledge slot in the routing queue until resolved, so duplication burns real equipment spend plus queue position.
